description.ja: 「機動戦士Z ガンダム」に登場する可変MS「ギャプラン」のHGUC仕様のプラモデル。シリーズ初の大型ブースターを付属、MS、MA形態それぞれに装着可能です。両腕の大型武器・メガ粒子砲の銃身スライド機構などにより、特徴あるフォルムを崩さずにMA形態への完全変形を再現可能です。ビームサーベル、台座が付属します。
description.en: An HGUC plastic model of the variable MS "Gaplan " that appears in " Mobile Suit Z Gundam". The first large booster in the series is included and can be attached to both MS and MA forms. Thanks to the large weapon on both arms and the barrel sliding mechanism of the mega particle cannon, it is possible to fully transform into MA form without losing its distinctive form. Beam saber and pedestal are included.
